channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Houthis threaten Saudi Arabia’s Aramco facilities and airports
item.description: Explosions in Sanaa reported shortly after Saudi-led coalition's evacuation order as Houthis promise 'harsh' response.

item.title: Yemeni government launches air strikes on Houthi positions
item.description: Yemeni rights group accuses the Houthis of killing five civilians and injuring more than a dozen others.

item.title: Iran sees ‘false flag’ operations after UK blames IRGC for airbase incident
item.description: Iran has been accused of being behind a plot against an airbase in the UK.

item.title: Iran threatens Gulf data centres: How exposed is the region’s internet?
item.description: Iran has warned that cables and data centres in the region could be attacked, as Houthi allies hold internet chokepoint.

item.title: Deadly Houthi attacks in Yemen’s Taiz as government forces advance in Marib
item.description: Government forces engage in intense clashes as Houthi shelling targets residential areas and hospitals in Taiz.

item.title: Yemeni families’ search for missing loved ones hindered by new fighting
item.description: Hundreds of people have gone missing in Yemen, with families not knowing whether they were killed in fighting or detained.

item.title: ‘My son was killed’: France faces backlash over police firearms bill
item.description: As protests nationwide protests rage, activists warn proposed law could lead to more impunity.

item.title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
item.description: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.

item.title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
item.description: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.
